v1 94.369/94.388. NO ERRORS SINCE, slow vocoder electro-soul at 96 bpm in 19-EDO: a machine's status lines become a love song without saying so.
- THE VOICE is realistic tts (--humanize 0.6). The verses are spoken: "everything is where you left it", "the fan is still turning", "all checks passed", "I counted every second".
- The choruses are speech to song: "no errors since" said four times until it is sung, every sung pitch rounded onto 19-EDO.
- The intro and outro voice comes through a radio fx with a drifting dial; the outro's "still here" six times, spoken to sung, tuning away.
- The bridge voice is ring-modulated and grained (cloud).
- THE TALKBOX: a saw pad plays the chords and the voice shapes it band by band (vocoder key: voice), so the harmony speaks the words.
- THE HARMONY is a Markov chain over 19-EDO chords, including the off-piano subminor 0-4-11 and supermajor 0-7-11. Its temperature drifts by section: cool verses lean home, the bridge runs hot (roots sliding a diesis, 63 or 126 cents).
- The band: a half-time 808, chance-gated hats, Rhodes comping with chance, analog bass in 19-EDO, a Juno pad.
Spectrum: v1 at first had a 71-133 Hz hole (bass an octave high) and no air; the bass moved down to C2-F#2, the mids came down 2 dB and a ride was added: spectrum 50 -> 88, cohesion 47 -> 100. Flow 2: t7's head is silent (-120 dB). -11.1 LUFS, TP -1.29, run 2. (Not queued.)
